risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may jam under load despite claim.

risks.risk: This is a 'PRO' production-class engine (high-volume, high-end optics/finishing), very different in capability and value from standard office-class bizhub/Sharp/Ricoh models in the comparable list.
risks.proof: Full spec sheet or serial-number lookup confirming PRO C754e production-line specs and accessories included.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be reliably priced against the listed comparables, which are all lower-tier office copiers

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and completing a live copy/print job.
Close-up photo of the page counter/meter report screen or printed report.
Photo of the open toner and drum compartment showing part condition or fitting date.
Photo showing the machine's current storage location (indoor vs outdoor) and condition of cabling/connectors.
Confirmation of included finishing units/trays (since PRO C754e often comes with finishers that affect price).
response.reason: The photographed item is clearly a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e, a production-class large-volume color press, but every comparable listed is a standard office-class copier/MFP (Sharp, lower Bizhub C-series, Ricoh MP), none of which match this machine's class or likely value, so no safe cheapest/dearest pick can be made from this list.
